title: Turn redo on a phone
description: The redo status strip covered 14-25% of a phone screen and its entry in the event log sat behind the turn action bar. Now it is one 46 px pill in the board toolbar strip that opens a sheet capped at 40% of the height above the bottom bars. Before and after at 390x844, 360x740 and landscape.

shots.caption: The phone event log drawer with the redo controls.

shots.heading: AFTER 390x844: Event log: Redo my last turn
shots.caption: The phone event log drawer with the redo controls.

notes.title: Before shots.
notes.text: Captured on the base commit (unified-latest-2026-10-08) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and committed as PNGs; npm run screenshots -- AW regenerates the after shots and asserts: strip at most 48 px, open sheet at most 40% of the viewport height, nothing of the header, toolbar, seat legend, Players / Events buttons, turn action bar or dialog buttons covered (at 360x740 with the turn bar up there is under 50 px of map between strip and bar, so the open sheet may cover the toolbar and seat legend there).

notes.title: Event log entry.
notes.text: On a phone with the turn action bar up, the open Events drawer was drawn under the bar and the Redo my last turn button could not be tapped (see the BEFORE 1-log-entry shot). The open drawer now rises above the bar; the Players / Events buttons stay on top.
